title: Generalized Lattice Models And Original Splittings
body_html:
Generalized Lattice Models And Original Splittings

Work in the setup of lattice_model_transition.pulled_back_symplectic_facet_setup.

For a pulled-back symplectic facet $F\in\mathcal{P}$, set

$$ \mathbf{b}_F:=L_F/L_F^+. $$

This is a finite symplectic vector space. Let

$$ (\bar\omega_{\mathbf{b}_F},\mathbf{S}(\mathbf{b}_F)) $$

be the finite oscillator representation attached to the finite Heisenberg group of $\mathbf{b}_F$.

The generalized lattice model at $F$ is

$$ \Omega_F:=\mathcal{S}(L_F), $$

where $\mathcal{S}(L_F)$ is the space of locally constant functions

$$ \Phi:W\to \mathbf{S}(\mathbf{b}_F) $$

compactly supported modulo $L_F$ and satisfying

$$ \Phi(a+w) = \psi\!\left(\tfrac12\langle w,a\rangle_W\right) \bar\omega_{\mathbf{b}_F}(\bar a)\Phi(w), \qquad a\in L_F,\ w\in W. $$

Here $\bar a$ is the image of $a$ in $\mathbf{b}_F=L_F/L_F^+$.

Let

$$ K_F:=\operatorname{Fix}_{\operatorname{Sp}(W)}(\mathfrak{f}_F) $$

be the pointwise fixer, equivalently the parahoric subgroup attached to the symplectic facet $\mathfrak{f}_F$.

The generalized lattice model gives an ordinary representation

$$ \rho_F:K_F\to\operatorname{GL}(\Omega_F) $$

after choosing the original lattice-model splitting of the metaplectic cover. Write this fixed splitting as

$$ s_F:K_F\to Mp(W). $$

The word "original" means that these are the splittings supplied by the lattice-model construction before any later twist by characters.

For an incidence $E\leq F$, the transition-map problem takes as fixed input that

$$ K_F\subseteq K_E. $$
